t: This is the home ground of the Worshipful Company of Leathersellers, one of the livery companies of the City of London. The company dates from the later part of the 14th century and received its Royal Charter in 1444, which makes it the senior livery company connected with the leather trade. Royal Navy officer William Locker was born here in 1731. He served with distinction during the eighteenth century, rising to the rank of captain, and held the posts of flag captain and commodore.
